narrative.highlights:
Staff Cost vs Budget:
Electrification Project:
Completion: 80%
Ongoing work:- Improvement of the grounding networks- Widening the control room to have access to the acquired cells Progress status:
Zamba 1st: two cabins installed, only the connection remains;
Malanga Cité: Snel have to send a letter to the AT of Songololo for the formalities of the new transformer location.
Staff incentives paid:
Bonus paid at Lubudi (100%), Zamba and HQ Kinshasa. Very positive reception on all three sites; staff committed to extra effort so the bonus becomes regular.
narrative.lowlights:
Road Safety: LOXEA accident near Nsele (Honoré Samba / Patrick Kodjowa). Investigations ongoing; CNPR engagement given Plant–HO accidents this year.
Resignations:
Clement Ndusha (Graduate) resigned in July (not yet in stats). Grassinda. Happy Iyanya — requested the 15th; asked to remain until 08/31 for handover (delay to confirm with ExCo).
Recruitment:
One of Lab Analyst (Zamba) declined the offer (re-advertise). CRO offers sent, awaiting response. Lab Analyst Plant and Warehouse Officer accepted
Community Relations:
The Nanga clan is in the process of regaining management of ZTL.
narrative.focus:
Family Day: Confirmed — 22 Aug at Zamba Plant; 5 Sep at Head Office (Kinshasa). Priority is organisation of both events.
MD Services replacement:
Procurement expected to close this month. Focus on transition and handover.
Office design payments:
Regarding the office design in Kinshasa, we are awaiting the additional PR approvals in order to proceed with the posting and payment of the remaining balance for the works
Early retirement — Charles Pongo-Pongo (QA Manager):  The recruitment of his replacement is underway
Medical cases:
Yannick Kalambayi (Instrumentation); Toubi Nzazi (Drilling); Lab employee (mental health) — contract expires August.

csrFy27Rows.name: Scholarship Programme
csrFy27Rows.objective: Provide educational support to students from host communities.
csrFy27Rows.progress: The programme is fully operational and continues to support beneficiaries in accordance with the approved framework.
csrFy27Rows.nextSteps: Continue monitoring academic performance and programme compliance.

csrFy27Rows.name: Zamba Water Tank Replacement
csrFy27Rows.objective: Planning the replacement of the defective and perforated tank with a new one already available.
csrFy27Rows.progress: The village's agreement for the new location of the tank
csrFy27Rows.nextSteps: The SOW has been prepared, and a tender process must be initiated by the Procurement department.

csrFy27Rows.name: Mwinda Partnership – Local PPE Manufacturing
csrFy27Rows.objective: Train and professionally integrate young women + produce PPE locally to reduce imports and delays
csrFy27Rows.progress: After procurement realized that Mwinda is a sole supplier, a Justification Form for Purchasing from a Sole Supplier was created and placed in the circuit for approval.

csrFy27Rows.name: PPC School
csrFy27Rows.objective: Legal status of the school signed
csrFy27Rows.progress: The contract is signed by MD

csrFy27Rows.name: Sewing Workshop
csrFy27Rows.objective: Develop vocational skills and improve employability of local women.
csrFy27Rows.progress: The training programme has been successfully completed, and certificates were awarded on 27 June 2026.
csrFy27Rows.nextSteps: Integrate graduates into the Mwinda PPE project to apply the skills acquired.

csrFy27Rows.name: Infrastructure Programme
csrFy27Rows.objective: Deliver community infrastructure projects under the Cahier des Charges.
csrFy27Rows.progress: Construction of two bridges linking Malanga Cité and Malanga Gare is progressing, with approximately 25% of clearing and stump removal completed. A third bridge has been added to facilitate access and transportation through the Malanga Gare railway corridor.
csrFy27Rows.risks: Land-related disputes may delay implementation of some infrastructure works.
csrFy27Rows.nextSteps: Continue civil works while resolving outstanding community issues affecting project implementation.

csrFy27Rows.name: Agriculture Programme
csrFy27Rows.objective: Promote sustainable livelihoods through community agriculture initiatives.
csrFy27Rows.progress: Resumption of agricultural activities for the communities of Nkumba and Malanga city planned for September 2026.
csrFy27Rows.risks: Finalise stakeholder discussions and resume agricultural activities once community consensus has been reached.
csrFy27Rows.nextSteps: Scheduling of Ploughing and Harrowing Activities

csrFy27Rows.name: Sports & Leisure Facilities
csrFy27Rows.objective: Promote youth development and community wellbeing through sports infrastructure.
csrFy27Rows.progress: inspection visit of the soccer field to be developed in Kumba for the start of work
csrFy27Rows.risks: No major risks identified at this stage.
csrFy27Rows.nextSteps:
Malanga Gare, the place has been indicated to set up a football field. The procedures are underway
inspection visit of the soccer field to be developed in Kumba for the start of work

cahierHighlights.title: Scholarship - Project fully in place
cahierHighlights.body: the construction of two bridges connecting Malanga Cité and Malanga Gare. 25% of the work, in terms of clearing and stump removal, is completed. A second project has been added to this. It involves the construction of a third bridge to facilitate both the evacuation and the transport of our products via the Malanga Gare railway. Negotiations with the residents of Kuzi were ongoing, but after a meeting held on this issue on Saturday, July 4th at Malanga Gare, we were informed that there is a land dispute between the lineages.

cahierHighlights.title: Agriculture
cahierHighlights.body: An online meeting was held with the Manalola organization, from which the lack of progress in the agricultural project was noted following land conflicts. A discussion about another methodology is underway to successfully carry the project through. However, we hope that a possible resumption of agricultural activities planned in Nkumba will take place in September as planned. Resumption of agricultural activities for the communities of Nkumba and Malanga city planned for September 2026.
